levels.surface: عبد الله بن مسلمة بن قعنب

notes: «- يعني ابن بلال -» is the editor's gloss; left out.
«عمر بن عبد العزيز» speaks inside Abd al-Rahman's story (he is heard asking); read as the encounter link before Saib, who answers.
The Prophet is not a link: the Companion al-Ala' relays his words.
